DeterminationBasis: T07-002 establishes detection and classification of a material governed-state change, while T07-005 addresses correction-forward treatment of a defective delta record. Neither directly requires an ordinary detected material change to be represented as a separate Delta Object or change representation distinct from the preserved predecessor state. Separate representation therefore remains a distinct test obligation.

The existing T07 tests detect and classify material change, test cosmetic concealment, preserve uncertainty where delta cannot be established, and preserve predecessor comparison during correction. None directly requires a Delta Object to identify the governing predicates affected by the change where that relationship can be established. Affected-predicate identification therefore remains a distinct test obligation.
